provenance.wording: Exploratory development results on one partition. The candidates were chosen after seeing 3C.1 results. Any final claim uses the existing reserved-recording protocol (the loco_* and other reserved-test columns in metadata.csv), opened once at the end. All nine fault classes have informed development decisions. Reserved recordings test those decisions; they do not establish performance on entirely new fault families.

e2_non_restrictive.interpretation: In these runs τ_s equals the maximum value the rank formula can produce, and ties are accepted, so the combined-score check rejects no recording; only the MSP check rejects. This follows the agreed rank-and-threshold design. E2 therefore does not test whether combining LR and CNN evidence helps; any redesigned combination would be a separately declared experiment.

disagreement_auroc.label: computed after the Stage 3D report; descriptive
